title: 第1章 哥，有狗惦记你妹子
slug: 狗哥你再舔女主我就和黄毛私奔
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“……对，给我染个五颜六色，颜色越亮越好！”

顶着三十五度的烈日，赵楹月踏入理发店，夸张的要求染个非主流发色。

店长认识赵楹月她哥。

闻言，苦口婆心的劝：“妹啊，你长这么乖，别搞非主流啊，我觉得浅茶色更适合你。”

赵楹月的眼神坚定的像要入党，“今天必须染！”

十分钟前，赵楹月还以为自己是马甲文女主。

十分钟后，她才恍然大悟，原来她是古早狗血文里，舔狗反派那丢失二十年的冤种妹妹。

女主叫孟以棠，是他们家保姆的女儿。

典型的柔弱坚韧小白花。

她哥赵随野，为了女主和男主对着干，最后落了个双腿截肢、面目全非的下场。

至于她弟和她爸妈，则被一起连累，死得老惨了！

总而言之，舔狗是没有好下场的！

赵楹月咬紧了后槽牙：还她泼天富贵！

一怒之下，她决定摊牌不装了。

回赵家前，村长反复叮嘱她到了家，一定要乖，不要惹事，不要染乱七八糟的发色，更不能像个机关枪一样，见人就干。

赵楹月满口答应。

回豪门一年多了，不是她吹，狗都没她听话。

现在想来，她就是听话过头了，才让赵随野闲得蛋疼去舔女主。

既然如此，那就别怪她搞事了！

三个小时后。

赵楹月盯着镜子里和云宝同款的彩虹发色，满意极了。

有点当年大姐大的风范了。

爽快的付了钱，又跑去商场大买特买。

精神小妹爱穿什么，她就买什么。

一身搭配下来，乖乖女的气质瞬间荡然无存，走在街上，回头率高达百分之两百。

上衣是件白色的紧身露脐短袖，下身搭了条破洞紧身牛仔裤，黑色的厚底松糕鞋，加上那一头非主流发色，简直像是上个年代的产物。

当赵楹月踏入赵家的那一刻，所有人惊呆了。

“大、大小姐？”管家不确定的喊了声。

赵楹月单手摘下墨镜，画着浓黑下垂眼线的狗狗眼弯了下，依旧是那副清甜的嗓子，她问：

“许叔，我哥呢？”

半个月前，赵母赵父借着处理国外业务的由头，抛下他们去过二人世界了。

弟弟正值高三冲刺期，一个月才会回家一趟。

平常家里只有她和大哥江随野。

“大小姐，”管家收起脸上的惊讶，重新换上一副标准的微笑，“大少爷正在书房。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"...Yes, dye it colorful for me. The brighter the color, the better!"

Under the 35-degree scorching sun, Zhao Yingyue stepped into the barber shop and made an exaggerated request to dye her hair a non-mainstream color.

The store manager knows Zhao Yingyue and her brother.

Hearing this, he earnestly advised: "Sister, you look so good, don't be unconventional. I think light brown is more suitable for you."

Zhao Yingyue's eyes were determined as if she wanted to join the party, "I must dye it today!"

Ten minutes ago, Zhao Yingyue thought she was the heroine of Ma Jiawen.

Ten minutes later, she suddenly realized that she was the wronged sister of the dog-licking villain in the ancient dog-blood novel who had been missing for twenty years.

The heroine is Meng Yitang, the daughter of their nanny.

A typical weak and tough little white flower.

Her brother Zhao Suiye fought against the male protagonist for the female protagonist, and ended up with both legs amputated and changed beyond recognition.

As for her brother and her parents, they were implicated together and died miserably!

All in all, licking a dog will not end well!

Zhao Yingyue clenched her molars: Give her back her wealth!

In a rage, she decided to show her cards and stop pretending.

Before returning to Zhao's house, the village chief repeatedly told her to be good when she got home, not to cause trouble, not to dye her hair in a messy color, and not to act like a machine gun and attack anyone in sight.

Zhao Yingyue agreed wholeheartedly.

It's been more than a year since she returned to a wealthy family, and even if she doesn't brag about it, even the dogs are not obedient to her.

Now that I think about it, she was overly obedient and allowed Zhao Suiye to lick the heroine with so much leisure.

If that's the case, don't blame her for causing trouble!

Three hours later.

Zhao Yingyue stared at the rainbow hair color that was the same as Yunbao's in the mirror, and was extremely satisfied.

She looks like a big sister back in the day.

I paid the money readily and went to the mall to buy a lot.

Whatever the spirited girl likes to wear, she will buy it.

After matching this outfit, the good-girl temperament disappears in an instant. When walking on the street, the head-turning rate is as high as 200%.

The top is a white tight-fitting midriff-baring short-sleeved shirt, with a pair of ripped skinny jeans on the lower body, black thick-soled platform shoes, and her non-mainstream hair color, which makes her look like a product of the last era.

The moment Zhao Yingyue stepped into the Zhao family, everyone was stunned.

"M-Miss?" the housekeeper called uncertainly.

Zhao Yingyue took off her sunglasses with one hand, her doggy eyes with thick black drooping eyeliner bent, and she still had that sweet voice, she asked:

"Uncle Xu, where is my brother?"

Half a month ago, Zhao's mother and Zhao's father left them behind to live in a world of two on the pretext of handling foreign business.

My younger brother is in the midst of his final year in high school and will only go home once a month.

Usually there are only her and her eldest brother Jiang Suiye at home.

"Miss," the housekeeper put away the surprise on his face and put on a standard smile again, "the young master is in the study."
